name: Skip, snooze or pause an order
summary: Skip the next order or pause the subscription, only if the order has not been processed by the pharmacy.

sources.title: How do I cancel my subscription? (snooze section)

steps.title: Verify identity
steps.instruction: Verify the patient with email and date of birth.

steps.title: Identify the program and order
steps.instruction: Call get_orders. If the patient has multiple active programs and did not say which, ask which treatment they mean.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.instruction: Only an order with status 'scheduled' can be skipped. If the next order is processing or dispatched, explain it is already with the pharmacy or carrier and cannot be changed, and offer to skip the following order instead.

steps.title: Make the change
steps.instruction: Use skip_next_order for a one-off skip, or pause_subscription with a resume date (max 90 days) for a longer break.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.instruction: Confirm the new next order date. Mention that if the break is because of side effects or results, the patient can message the medical team via the Medical Care tab.

eligibility.rule: Orders that are processing, dispatched or delivered cannot be skipped.
A pause can be at most 90 days.
Cancelled subscriptions cannot be paused or skipped.

escalation.when: Patient wants to stop treatment because of side effects or symptoms
